name: Physically Based API -- materials database
used_by: scripts/physically_based.py (read by scripts/aircraft_look.py for the aircraft master materials' measured constants)
note: Vendored whole (byte-identical to the upstream file at the pinned commit) so the sha256 is the upstream file's. Colours are linear sRGB base colours: for a metal the base colour is its normal-incidence reflectance F0 (metalness workflow); for a dielectric the ior gives F0 = ((n - 1) / (n + 1))^2.
